author: Kat
title: Paid B&W illustrations for short story series
content: Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work. NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art. I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story. What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives “Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark”. Maybe a little less intricate, but I want that “I’ve seen flashes of this in my dreams” creepy feeling. Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration, because I don’t know but I want to do this the right way. If you’re an artist who likes to read, even better. I have most of one short done now, have 12 total planned. Artist would get credit as the artist/illustrator for publishing. Contact: DM @katinnnky on Threads.

author: Collins
title: Urgent original artwork for personal project
content: URGENTLY LOOKING FOR ARTIST. Need some original artwork done for a personal project. Looking for a creative person who can follow references but still add their own touch. Good communication is important. Budget: £70–£115. Beginners with decent samples can apply too. Contact: DM @colli.ns258 on Threads.
